ja_text:
ジョ……ジョークだ
バルジェロ
en_text: J-just kidding, Boss! Sheesh...

ja_text:
このパーティで
さらに顧客を増やす気か
en_text:
She's looking to expand her
clientele, no doubt.

ja_text: 嫌でも増えるだろうさ
en_text: ...And she'll get them.

ja_text:
ヘルミニアの“商品”は
別格だからな……
en_text:
After all, no one can resist
Lady Herminia's "product."

ja_text: おい、あれ……
en_text: Hey, is that—?

ja_text: 大富豪ヘルミニアだぞ……
en_text: It's her!

ja_text: 皆様、御機嫌よう
en_text: Good evening, everyone.

ja_text:
わたくしのパーティへ
お越しいただき、感謝しますわ
en_text: ...And welcome to my banquet.

ja_text:
贅の限りを尽くした
食事をお召し上がりください
en_text:
My servants have prepared a feast
of the finest delicacies in the realm.

ja_text: ああでも……
en_text: Oh, but of course...

ja_text:
メインディッシュは
こちらですのよ
en_text: This...is the main dish.

ja_text:
おいおい……
天国かよ……
en_text: Whoa! Is this heaven?

ja_text:
楽しそう！
俺たちも混ざりたい！
en_text: I want a piece of the action!

ja_text:
……バカ言え
あれには絶対に手を出すな
en_text: Don't be a fool.

ja_text:
わたくしの“粉”は
ご存知ですわよね？
en_text:
You are familiar with
my product, yes?

ja_text:
これを一吸いすれば
別世界へ誘われますわ
en_text:
One whiff and you'll be transported
to a world of sheer bliss.

ja_text: 世は辛く、残酷です
en_text:
This world is cruel and
unforgiving.

ja_text:
ですのに、立ち向かう程
価値もございませんの
en_text:
Why waste your time struggling
through a dreary existence?

ja_text: ……夢を見ましょう
en_text: Tonight, let yourself dream...

ja_text:
ふふ……
至極の夢を約束しますわ
en_text:
And I promise that all your
dreams will be beautiful...

ja_text: ご満足いただけて光栄ですわ
en_text: I trust you're all satisfied.

ja_text:
もっと召し上がって
構いませんのよ？
en_text: Do feel free to indulge some more.

ja_text:
帰って来れなくなるかも
ふふ……
en_text:
But watch out.
You may never want to return...

ja_text:
さあ、皆様
存分にお愉しみくださいな！
en_text:
Envelop yourselves in rapture and
bliss, my dear guests!

ja_text: タヴィアーニだ
en_text: It's Taviani.

ja_text:
ここらの“粉”を仕切ってたが
ヘルミニアに取って代わられた
en_text:
He used to sell his product here
until Lady Herminia took over.

ja_text:
ああ
内心穏やかじゃないだろう
en_text:
...He can't be too happy about
the current situation.

ja_text:
あら、タヴィアーニさん
お噂はかねがね……
en_text:
Lord Taviani, I presume?
I've heard so much about you...

ja_text:
お招きに感謝します
麗しいお姿だ、ゴッドマザー
en_text:
And you, Lady Herminia, are
even lovelier than the tales say...

ja_text:
仮面の下も
さぞお美しいのでしょうな
en_text:
I can scarce imagine what beauty
lies beneath that mask...

ja_text:
素顔は明かさないの
仕事柄、敵が多くてね
en_text:
Forgive me. My line of work
has earned me many foes...

ja_text:
ふふ
富は敵を作るものです
en_text:
Indeed. Great riches invite
great enemies...

ja_text:
貴方ほど敵のいる人物を
他に知りません
en_text:
...And your riches are the greatest
in the realm.

ja_text: 御上手ね
en_text: You are kind to say so.

ja_text:
じつは私も、厄介な敵に
手を焼いているのです
en_text:
In truth, I have found myself
a troublesome foe as well.

ja_text:
長年、この地域は
我が一族のものでしたが
en_text:
For many years, my house held
sway in these lands.

ja_text:
どこぞの“魔女”に
縄張りを荒らされていましてな
en_text:
...Until a greedy witch stole from
us what was rightfully ours.

ja_text:
助言して差し上げますわ
タヴィアーニさん
en_text: A word of advice, Lord Taviani.

ja_text:
畑を焼かれるより早く
隣の畑を焼け、ですわ
en_text:
You'd be wise to burn your
neighbor's house before your
own bursts into flame.

ja_text:
ほう、これは
良い知恵をいただいた
en_text:
Sage advice, indeed.
I thank you, my lady.

ja_text:
失礼しました
つい戯言を
en_text: Pray forgive my innocent jest.

ja_text: 冗談も御上手ですのね
en_text:
Your sense of humor is most
impressive.

ja_text:
ふふ、緊張して
喉が渇きませんこと？
en_text:
But has the tension in the air
parched your throat?

ja_text:
いかがかしら？
自慢のワインですの
en_text:
Mayhap milord would enjoy
a glass of my finest wine?

ja_text:
お近づきの印に
ふふ……
en_text:
As a toast to our newfound
friendship...

ja_text:
お、おい？
あれ、毒じゃ……
en_text:
What the—
It must be poisoned...!

ja_text: しっ！　黙ってろ！
en_text: Shh! Hold your tongue!

ja_text:
……あいにく
酒は苦手でしてな
en_text:
...Forgive me, my lady. Spirits
have never agreed with me.

ja_text:
誰か、このワインを
飲める者はいないか！
en_text:
Is there no one here who will
drink this wine in my stead!?

ja_text:
宴の主に失礼をしたくない！
さあ、誰か！
en_text:
Come forth, now! We cannot
disrespect the lady of the house!

ja_text: バ……バルジェロ！？
en_text: Bargello!?

ja_text:
こっち来い！
なに考えてんだよ！
en_text:
G-get back here!
Have you lost your wits!?

ja_text:
いただきます
ワインに目がないもので
en_text:
It would be my honor to partake
of this fine vintage, my lady.

ja_text:
特に……
危険な香りのワインには
en_text:
I cannot resist a good wine—
especially one with such a...
dangerous aroma.

ja_text:
……ほう
若者よ、名を聞こうか？
en_text:
...Oho! Might I ask your name,
young man?

ja_text: バルジェロ・ギベルティ
en_text: I am Bargello...of House Ghiberti.

ja_text:
ウォルド産の赤ブドウですね
……美味いです
en_text:
An excellent vintage, I must say.
From the Wold region, no doubt?

ja_text: くっはっはっは！！
en_text: Bwahahahahahaha!

ja_text:
肝の据わったやつだ
気に入ったぞ！
en_text:
You've got nerve, my boy!
I like that!

ja_text: バルジェロ……
en_text: Boss...

ja_text: 面白そうな坊やね
en_text:
You're a fascinating young man,
aren't you?

ja_text:
おい知ってるか？
ヘルミニアの“粉”の作り方
en_text:
You know how Lady Herminia
makes her "product," right?

ja_text:
いいや、あれだけの質と量を
一体どうやって……
en_text:
Not quite... How <i>does</> she make
such a large quantity at this quality?

ja_text: それがな……
en_text: Well...

ja_text:
この屋敷の裏……
広大な敷地に何があると思う？
en_text:
You know what you'll find behind
this mansion?

ja_text: 畑だよ
en_text: Fields.

ja_text:
“粉”を作るために耕された
畑が拡がってるらしい
en_text:
Fields stretching out for
leagues and leagues...

ja_text:
そこに奴隷を雇い入れ
栽培させていると……
en_text:
And they say she's got a veritable
legion of slaves working them...

ja_text: 入れ
en_text: ...Enter.

ja_text:
収穫量を報告して
くださるかしら？
en_text: Well? I would hear your report.

ja_text:
今月の収穫は
４６００ガロンほどです
en_text:
We've harvested 4,600 gallons'
worth this month, my lady.

ja_text:
先月より１００ガロンほど
少ないのではなくて？
en_text:
That's 100 fewer gallons than last
month. Or am I mistaken?

ja_text:
申し訳ありません
体調を崩す者が増え……
en_text:
N-no, my lady. Some of us
have fallen sick, you see...

ja_text:
身を粉にして働いておりますが
もう……限界です
en_text:
W-we're working as hard as we can,
my lady, but...we're at our limit.

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様
どうかご慈悲を……
en_text:
P-please, Lady Herminia...
Have mercy...

ja_text: まだ余力があるようね？
en_text: What foolishness is this?

ja_text:
文句を言う力があるなら
働きなさい
en_text:
Maybe you should work harder
instead of making pathetic excuses!

ja_text: ……待って
en_text: ...This can't be.

ja_text:
わたくしのドレスに
血が付きましたわよ？
en_text: Did you get blood on my dress?

ja_text:
これはメリノワームという
幼虫の繭で作っていますの
en_text:
This dress was made from the
finest silk of the merino worm...

ja_text:
このドレスでお前たちが
何人買えると思う？
en_text:
Do you know how many of you
I could buy for the price of this
dress?

ja_text: も、申し訳ありません……！
en_text: F-forgive me, my lady!

ja_text:
謝罪で
金は償えませんわ
en_text:
Your pathetic groveling won't
make me any money!

ja_text:
ああ……
胸クソ悪い……
en_text: You make me sick...all of you.

ja_text:
奴隷ごときがどうして
わたくしと同じ血の色を？
en_text:
Why? <i>Why</> do these dirty slaves
bleed the same color as I!?

ja_text: 許せませんわ……
en_text: Filthy insects... Damn you all...

ja_text:
わたくしが白いドレスを着たら
白い血を噴きなさい！
en_text:
This time, bleed white.
Bleed <i>white</>, I say!

ja_text:
やだ……
また赤い……
en_text:
Red...?
Red again?

ja_text:
ああ……許せませんわ
許せませんわぁ……
en_text:
I cannot take this...
I cannot take this anymore!

ja_text:
言うことをお聞きなさい！
この虫どもめッ！！
en_text:
Can't you maggots do <i>anything</>
right!?

ja_text: ヘルミニア様……
en_text: Lady Herminia...

ja_text:
命令を聞けない
奴隷に価値はありませんわ
en_text:
Slaves who disobey their mistress
are worth less than nothing...

ja_text:
さあ、次はどなたが
躾けてほしいのかしら？
en_text:
Now, who will receive their
punishment next?

ja_text: ひ……ひッ……
en_text: Gods...gods have mercy...

ja_text: ひいぃぃぃッ！！
en_text: N-no! Please!

ja_text: ふふ……お逃げなさい
en_text:
Yes... Scatter like the insects
you are.

ja_text:
人を支配するには
金だけでは不足ですわ
en_text:
Few understand...that coin is
not enough to rule over people.

ja_text:
もう１つ
必要なものがありますの
en_text:
There is one more thing that is
oh-so-important.

ja_text: ……恐怖ですわ
en_text: ...Fear.

ja_text:
ほどほどに
間引いて差し上げて
en_text: Cull the herd.

ja_text: はッ！
en_text: Yes, ma'am!

ja_text: あー楽しかったッ！
en_text: Now <i>that</> was a banquet!

ja_text: へへ、また来ようぜ
en_text: Hehe. We should come back sometime.

ja_text:
ティツィアーノ
ここをどこだと思ってる？
en_text:
Have you gone mad?
Remember where we are, Tiziano.

ja_text:
名は売った
長居は無用だ
en_text:
We did what we needed to do.
Now let's get out of here.

ja_text:
……おい
なんだよ、あれ
en_text:
...Wait. Over there—
What's that?
Hmm...?

ja_text: 奴隷が……殺られてる
en_text:
H-he's dead...
They're all dead...

ja_text: ひでえ……
en_text: It can't be...

ja_text: 許せねえ……
en_text: ...She'll pay for this.

ja_text: お前ら、行くぞ
en_text: With me, everyone.

ja_text:
え？
長居は無用って……
en_text:
Huh? Didn't you just say we were
getting out of here?

ja_text:
やれやれ……こう見えて
熱いとこがあるからな
en_text:
Seems more passion burns inside
you than you let on, eh?

ja_text:
仕方ねえ
ボスには従わなきゃな！
en_text:
Heh! Well, wherever the boss
goes, I go!

ja_text:
……なあ
お前も来るよな？
en_text:
...And you.
You're coming, too, right?

ja_text:
へえ？　お前のあだ名は
“腐れチキン”になるぜ
en_text:
Huh? You came all this way, and
you're going to chicken out now!?

ja_text:
……なあ
お前も来るよな？
en_text:
Seriously, though...
You're coming with us, right?

ja_text: そうこなくっちゃな！
en_text: That's the spirit!

ja_text: 悪く思うな……
en_text: ...It's nothing personal.

ja_text: 何者だ！？
en_text: What do you think you're doing!?

ja_text:
ガキか……？
貴様らが来る場所ではない
en_text: ...This is no place for children.

ja_text:
へえ……あんた
強そうなのにな
en_text: Heh... You look like a strong one.

ja_text:
金さえもらえば
弱者も平気で殺すのかい？
en_text:
More than happy to slaughter
innocents for the right price,
are you?

ja_text:
我々はヘルミニア様の兵
雇い主の命令を聞くだけだ
en_text:
I am in the employ of Lady Herminia.
I was simply following orders.

ja_text:
そうかよ
要は金好きな犬だろ？
en_text:
Yeah, right. You're just a rabid dog
slavering for coin.

ja_text:
……どかぬと殺すぞ
ガキども
en_text:
...If you value your lives,
begone from this place.

ja_text: どかないね
en_text: We're not going anywhere.

ja_text:
それと、俺はバルジェロ
ガキじゃない
en_text:
...And we're not children.
My name is Bargello.

ja_text:
これから名を上げる男だ
憶えておけ
en_text: ...You'd do well to remember it.

ja_text:
無理だ、バルジェロ
そいつは記憶できねえ
en_text:
Give it up, Boss. This bastard
won't be remembering anything.

ja_text:
ああ
ここで死ぬンだからさ
en_text: Yeah! He'll be dead!

ja_text: ……忠告はしたぞ
en_text: ...I warned you.

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様に
報告するまでもない
en_text:
You're not even worth mentioning
to Lady Herminia.

ja_text:
死体が数人増えたところで
どうせ分からぬ……
en_text:
I doubt she'd notice a few more
corpses anyway...

ja_text:
やったぜ！
俺たちを舐めンなよ！
en_text:
We did it!
Serves the bastard right!

ja_text: なぜだ……
en_text: Why, damn it...

ja_text:
なぜ貧しい者は
金持ちの食い物にされる？
en_text:
Why does the blood of the poor
line the pockets of the rich!?

ja_text: バルジェロ……
en_text: Boss...

ja_text: 俺たちは、デカくなる
en_text: We're going to make it big...

ja_text:
そして
この手で取り戻してやる
en_text:
Mark my words... We're going to
take everything from her...

ja_text:
あの魔女に支配される前の
俺たちの町を
en_text:
We're going to take back
this town...

ja_text:
少しはマシだった
あの町を……
en_text:
...And make it a real place to
live again.

ja_text: さあ、今日はお開きですわ
en_text:
I'm afraid our party must draw
to a close.

ja_text:
お気をつけて
お帰りあそばせ？
en_text:
Do take care on your way home,
yes?

ja_text:
わたくしの商品をご所望なら
またお尋ねくださいな
en_text:
And should you ever desire more
of my "product"...

ja_text:
お待ちしていますわ
ふふ……
en_text:
...You need only say the word.
Heh heh heh...

ja_text:
素敵なパーティでした
ゴッドマザー
en_text:
'Twas a fabulous banquet,
my lady.

ja_text:
気に入っていただけて
光栄ですわ
en_text: You honor me to say so, my lord.

ja_text:
大人しくなさい
タヴィアーニさん
en_text: Tread carefully, Taviani...

ja_text:
貴方の時代は
過ぎ去りましたわ
en_text: Your time has come and gone...

ja_text:
バルジェロ
どういうつもりだ？
en_text: What's the meaning of this, Boss?

ja_text:
ああ、俺らは
誰にも飼われないぜ？
en_text: Yeah! We're no one's dogs, right?

ja_text: いいか、お前ら
en_text: Listen up, now.

ja_text:
ヘルミニアは強大だ
いまは手も足も出ない
en_text:
Lady Herminia's too powerful.
There's no way we can fight her
head-on.

ja_text:
だから、俺たちは
利用できるものはしていく
en_text:
So we'll use what we can...
and who we can.

ja_text:
犬のフリして
逆に飼い馴らしてやるのさ
en_text:
We'll play the role of the dog until
we get close enough to bite her.
Oho!

ja_text:
犬のフリならできるぜ？
バウバウバウ！
en_text:
Ruff! Arf!
Yeah, I can do this!

ja_text: うまいぞ、ピエロ
en_text: Not half bad, Pierro.

ja_text:
<chara_name>
これから忙しくなる
en_text:
Things might get a little messy
from here on out, <chara_name>.

ja_text: あんたにも期待してるぞ
en_text: ...But I know I can count on you.

ja_text: ……お、来たぜ
en_text: There he is.

ja_text: ……“強欲の魔女”め
en_text: That bloody witch...

ja_text: タヴィアーニさん
en_text: ...Lord Taviani.

ja_text:
……バルジェロ
だったな
en_text: Bargello, was it?

ja_text: 俺たちはこの町で育った
en_text: I was born and raised in this town.

ja_text:
俺たちをあなたの下で
働かせてください
en_text: And so I ask: let us work for you.

ja_text: きっと、力になります
en_text:
I think you'll find us more than
useful...
Hm...

ja_text:
いいだろう
お前は気に入った
en_text:
...I like you, boy.
You have yourself a deal.

ja_text: おい、やったぜ！
en_text: All right!

ja_text: バカ……はしゃぐな
en_text: Settle down, you fool.

ja_text: さっそく働いてもらおう
en_text:
If you don't mind, I'll be putting
you right to work.

ja_text: ありがたき幸せ……
en_text: It'd be our pleasure.

ja_text: ふふ……
en_text: Oho...

ja_text: うふふふふ……
en_text: Ohohohohohoho...

ja_text: ああ……
en_text: Ahhh!

ja_text: そう……そうよ……
en_text: Yes... Oh, yes...

ja_text:
穢れが
清められていくわ……
en_text:
I feel so cleansed...
So pure...

ja_text: ああ……
en_text: Ahhhhhh...
Such bliss...

ja_text:
富だけが
わたくしの味方……
en_text:
My gold...
My diamonds...

ja_text: わたくしの全て……
en_text: You are my only friends...

ja_text: 富こそが……
en_text: You are...all of me.

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様
本日のご予定を……
en_text:
Lady Herminia.
Your agenda for today...

ja_text:
この後
資産家オットゥ氏と商談……
en_text:
First on the schedule is negotiations
with Master Otto of the Consortium...

ja_text:
ベケル家とマズローネ家
とのご昼食……
en_text:
After that, lunch with representatives
from Houses Beckel and Mazrone.

ja_text: ……もう、結構ですわ
en_text: ...Enough.

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様
それと、気になることが
en_text:
...Lady Herminia.
One more thing worries me.

ja_text:
フロストランドでの
取引ですが……
en_text:
Regarding your dealings in
the Frostlands...

ja_text:
ドン・タヴィアーニに
不穏な動きがあるようです
en_text:
Word has it that Lord Taviani is
attempting to interfere...

ja_text:
ふふ……
タヴィアーニさんも忙しいわね
en_text:
Oho...
The man keeps himself busy, no?

ja_text:
ご心配は不要よ
手は打ってありますの
en_text:
There is no cause for concern.
I have already seen to the matter.

ja_text:
富で動かぬものなど
ありませんわ
en_text:
There is nothing my wealth
cannot buy.

ja_text: ふふふ……
en_text: Ohohoho...

ja_text: タヴィアーニが何の用だ？
en_text: What do you think Taviani wants?

ja_text:
俺たちを直に呼ぶとか
初めてだよな
en_text:
Yeah, this is the first time he's
called for us directly.

ja_text:
自分の女の世話でも
させるンじゃねえ？
en_text:
Maybe he wants us to entertain
one of his mistresses?

ja_text: そいつは悪いジョークだ
en_text: You must be kidding.

ja_text:
女ってのは
財布が幾つあっても足りねえ
en_text:
There's no faster way to burn
a hole in your coin purse.

ja_text: 金で男の気持ちを確かめてる
en_text: That's how they measure men.

ja_text:
貢がれるほど
想われてるって幸せ感じるのさ
en_text:
The more you spend on them,
the more they love you.

ja_text:
……はいはい
つまりこうだろ？
en_text: ...I see. So what you're saying is...

ja_text: “いい女を抱きたきゃ、金を稼げ”
en_text:
If you want a good mistress,
you gotta pay for the privilege.

ja_text:
へへ……
わかったか、新入り？
en_text:
Heh... You taking notes,
newcomer?

ja_text: クールだな
en_text: ...It's go time.

ja_text: ……やれやれ
en_text: ...Ridiculous.

ja_text:
あッ！　バルジェロ！
自分だけ格好つける気か？
en_text:
Hah! So you're too noble for this.
Is that it, Boss?

ja_text:
“金で女を買って満足か”
とでも言いたげじゃん！？
en_text:
It's like he's saying he's not
interested in paying for pleasure.

ja_text: 金で女を買って満足か？
en_text:
...I'm <i>not</> interested in
paying for pleasure.

ja_text:
おそらく
もっとヤバい仕事だ
en_text:
Anyway, I'll bet the job's
not nearly so innocent.

ja_text:
タヴィアーニが内密に
伝えるほどだからな
en_text:
Taviani must have had a reason
for keeping it secret...

ja_text:
バルジェロ……
予想以上の働きぶりだ
en_text:
...Bargello.
You've done good work for us.

ja_text:
お前たちが入り
組織はすこぶる調子がいい
en_text:
Why, ever since you've joined up,
our fortunes have grown even greater.

ja_text: やはり、俺の眼は確かだった
en_text:
Yes, I saw something in you
from the start.

ja_text:
バルジェロ、次は
デカい仕事を任せるぞ？
en_text:
How would you like to take on
your biggest task yet?

ja_text: 願ってもないですね
en_text: We'd like nothing more.

ja_text:
エンバーグロウの北西に
とある地下遺跡があってな
en_text:
Good. Northwest of the town of
Emberglow lies an underground
ruin.

ja_text:
そこは“粉”の隠し場所で
取引場所でもある
en_text:
It houses a massive stock of powder.
It's also where a deal will go down.

ja_text:
……近く、大きな取引で
ヘルミニアがやって来るらしい
en_text:
...They say Lady Herminia herself
is going to show.

ja_text: ……で、仕事の内容は？
en_text:
All right.
So where do we come in?

ja_text: あの魔女を葬る
en_text: ...You're going to take her out.

ja_text:
燃やして灰にして……
“粉”にしてやる
en_text:
Kill her, burn her...turn her
to ashes.

ja_text:
なるほど
かなりの“火”が要りますね
en_text:
...I see.
We're going to need a big fire.

ja_text: そういうことだ
en_text: Just so.

ja_text:
お前たちは
エンバーグロウに出発しろ
en_text:
You're going to make for Emberglow
at once.

ja_text:
俺の右腕を
待たせてある……
en_text:
My right hand will be waiting
for you there.

ja_text: バルジェロ……
en_text: Bargello...

ja_text:
ああ
願ってもない好機だ
en_text:
We couldn't have asked
for anything more.

ja_text:
へへ、こんなに早く
廻って来るとはな
en_text:
Hehe! To think we'd get this chance,
and so quickly!

ja_text: ぬかるなよ、お前ら
en_text: We can't afford to mess this up.

ja_text:
俺たちは、ヘルミニアを倒し
新たな時代を作る
en_text:
We're going to take out Herminia
and forge a new future.

ja_text: ……やるか？
en_text: Shall we?

ja_text:
何やってンだ
入れよ、仲間だろ？
en_text:
What are you waiting for?
You're one of us, right?

ja_text: “カッティーナ”
en_text: For the family!

ja_text: ……集まったな
en_text:
...All right.
Everyone's here.

ja_text:
さて、タヴィアーニの右腕と
落ち合う予定だが……
en_text:
We're going to be meeting with
Taviani's right hand.

ja_text: 右腕ってどんなヤツなんだ？
en_text: I wonder what they're like.

ja_text: そこが重要だぜ
en_text:
Yeah. That'll make or break
this job.

ja_text: お、おい……
en_text: W-wait...

ja_text:
あれって
もしかして……
en_text:
Is that—?
It can't be...

ja_text: ソニア……か？
en_text:
Sonia...
Is that you?

ja_text:
しばらくだね
バルジェロ
en_text: Long time no see, Bargello.

ja_text: ……と、その取巻き
en_text:
...And I see you brought your
toadies, too.

ja_text: おいおいおい！
en_text: Watch your language, woman!

ja_text:
いい女になっても
口は相変わらずだな
en_text:
You haven't changed a bit,
have you?

ja_text: へへ、１０年ぶりか？
en_text: How long has it been? Ten years?

ja_text:
仲良くしようぜ
一緒に臭いメシ食った仲だ
en_text:
We went through a lot back then.
It's good to be together again.

ja_text: ……見慣れない人もいる
en_text: ...I don't believe I've met this one.

ja_text:
こいつは新入りだ
信頼できる
en_text:
They're new to the family,
but trustworthy all the same.

ja_text:
ああ、こいつのお陰で
ここまで来れたンだ
en_text:
Yeah! We'd never have made
it this far without them.

ja_text:
へえ……
なかなかやるのね
en_text:
I see... You must be something
special, then.

ja_text:
しかし、お前が
タヴィアーニの右腕とはな
en_text:
Heh... To think you're Taviani's
right hand.

ja_text:
どこで道を踏み外したンだ
ソニア？
en_text:
...But I never thought you'd
end up in this line of work.

ja_text:
あたしはあたしの
目標に向かってるだけ
en_text:
It's a means to an end,
just like it is for you.

ja_text:
貧民に生まれたって
夢くらい見させてよ
en_text:
Who says a pauper girl
can't have big dreams?

ja_text:
明日、ヘルミニアが
地下遺跡に現れる
en_text:
Tomorrow, Lady Herminia
will show up at the ruins.

ja_text:
タヴィアーニさんと合流し
始末するわ
en_text:
We'll rendezvous with Lord Taviani
and do the deed.

ja_text: ゆっくり休んでおくことね
en_text: Sleep well. You'll need your strength.

ja_text:
……で、そのワインを
飲み干したの？
en_text:
...And you drained the whole
glass? In front of everyone?

ja_text: くっくっく……
en_text: Hahahah!

ja_text:
タヴィアーニさんが
気に入るわけだね
en_text:
No wonder Lord Taviani
took a liking to you...

ja_text: そういうことだ
en_text: That's how it went down.

ja_text: ……どうした？
en_text: ...What is it, Sonia?

ja_text:
あんたと組むなんて
運命みたいなのを感じる
en_text:
It's almost like fate brought us
together, after all this time.

ja_text: ロマンチストだな
en_text:
When did you become
such a romantic?

ja_text:
子供の頃
よく一緒に悪さしたよね
en_text:
We were always causing trouble
when we were kids, weren't we?

ja_text: ほら、覚えてる……？
en_text: Do you remember?

ja_text:
あたしたちの町
シロブドウが咲くでしょ？
en_text:
When the white grape blossoms
bloomed back home...

ja_text:
あのブドウ、一緒に
何度も盗もうとしたわね
en_text:
We'd always go and try to steal
our share.

ja_text:
春に、白い花が咲くたび
あの頃を思い出すわ
en_text:
Even now, every spring...
I remember those days.

ja_text:
その日の食べ物も知れない
貧しさを……
en_text:
How we never knew where our
next meal was coming from...

ja_text:
……懐かしいな
ソニアの家も農家だった
en_text:
I remember, too... Your parents
were humble farmers, just like
mine...

ja_text:
あのシロブドウ
上質なワインになるってな
en_text:
To think that those grapes make the
wine those greedy bastards drink...

ja_text: ……うん
en_text: ...Indeed.

ja_text:
俺はあいつらと町を出たが
お前はどうしていた？
en_text:
So...what did you do after
I left town?

ja_text: あの後、農園は買われたの
en_text:
Not long after, we lost our
vineyards...

ja_text: 大富豪ヘルミニアに
en_text:
They were taken from us.
By Lady Herminia.

ja_text:
あのシロブドウ畑は
家の財産だった
en_text: The vineyards were all we had.

ja_text:
それを無理やり奪われ
親は貧しいまま死んだわ
en_text:
Mother and Father died, even
poorer than they had been.

ja_text:
だから、あたしはヘルミニアから
財産を奪い返す道を選んだ
en_text:
...I swore a vow that I would take
our fortune back from that witch.

ja_text:
そしたら、父と母が
報われる気がして
en_text:
It's the least I can do to give my
parents peace.

ja_text:
……で
タヴィアーニについたのか
en_text: ...And so you fell in with Taviani.

ja_text:
そうよ……
この手も随分と汚したわ
en_text:
I did. Ever since then, I've been
doing his dirty work.

ja_text:
でも、あたしは
どうなってもいい
en_text:
But I don't care how far
I've fallen.

ja_text:
あのシロブドウ畑を
取り戻すまではね
en_text:
I'll sink to the deepest hell
to take back what's ours...

ja_text:
俺たちの町は
魔女に買われ、おかしくなった
en_text:
Hell—that's what our town has
been ever since that witch took
over.

ja_text:
この手で
マシな町を取り戻そう
en_text:
...But we're going to take it back,
and make things right again.

ja_text: うん
en_text: We will.

ja_text: いいか？　バルジェロ
en_text: Listen up, Bargello.

ja_text:
お前らは、直進し
相手の戦力を削いでいけ
en_text:
Your job will be to take out
our quarry's bodyguards.

ja_text:
ソニアたちは先行して
見張りを殺せ
en_text:
Sonia and her men will go in first
and see to their lookouts.

ja_text:
最奥で取引が
行われているはずだ
en_text:
The transaction is being conducted
in the innermost chamber.

ja_text:
ヘルミニアは俺がやる
……わかったな？
en_text:
The witch herself you leave
to me. Got it?

ja_text:
危険な仕事になる
覚悟して行け
en_text:
I'll put it straight—we may
not come out of here alive.

ja_text:
帰ったら
とびきり上等な酒で祝おう
en_text:
...But if we do, we'll share a toast
with the finest wine in the realm.

ja_text:
<chara_name>、覚悟はいいか？
頼りにしてるぜ
en_text:
You ready, <chara_name>?
We're counting on you.

ja_text:
へえ？　お前のあだ名は
“凍りチキン”になるぜ
en_text:
What's that? Bawk-bawk!?
No, seriously now.

ja_text:
いいじゃんか
いっちょカマそうぜ……
en_text: All right! This is our time to shine!

ja_text:
ん？　ピエロ
脚が震えてるぞ？
en_text: Pierro...are your legs shaking?

ja_text:
気のせいだろ！？
さ、寒いだけだし！
en_text:
It's n-nothing!
I'm just c-cold, that's all!

ja_text: たしかに、クールだ
en_text: It's—brrrrrrrrr—go time.

ja_text: ……じゃあね
en_text: ...See you inside.

ja_text: ああ
en_text: Be safe.

ja_text: バルジェロ……
en_text: Bargello...

ja_text: いいぞ、順調だな……
en_text:
All right.
Everything looks in order...

ja_text:
ソニアとタヴィアーニが
この先で待っているはずだ
en_text:
Sonia and Taviani will be waiting
for us up ahead.

ja_text:
あと少しで……
魔女を追い詰められる
en_text:
Not much longer now... That witch
will get what's coming to her...

ja_text: へへ、急ごうぜ
en_text: Haha! I can hardly wait!

ja_text:
おい……？
なんだよ、あれ
en_text: Up ahead... What's that?

ja_text:
じいさん、イカすな
ここに住んでるのか？
en_text:
Huh? What's an old geezer like
you doing in a place like this?

ja_text:
無知な者め
立ち去るがいい
en_text:
...Fools. If you value your lives,
begone from this accursed place.

ja_text:
……笑わせてくれるぜ
さては旅芸人か？
en_text:
...That's a good one.
You must be a traveling minstrel!

ja_text:
ここは昔
ある大富豪の領地……
en_text:
This was once the domain of a
wealthy trader...

ja_text:
私は
その使用人じゃった……
en_text: I served him...as his loyal butler.

ja_text: ジョークだろ？　昔話かよ
en_text:
Now you're telling us a story?
You must be kidding me...

ja_text:
そこどきな
俺たちは忙しいの
en_text:
Beat it, gramps.
We're here on important business.

ja_text:
ここへ来たあんたらにも
関係がある話じゃ
en_text:
If that is so, you'd do well
to heed my words.

ja_text:
よいか？
これは“警告”じゃぞ
en_text:
Do you hear me? This is your
first—and only—warning.

ja_text:
その骨が折れる音を
先に聞きたいか？
en_text:
Out of our way, you old coot,
unless you want both legs broken.

ja_text: よせ
en_text: ...No. Let's hear him out.

ja_text:
私は
あの家で悪夢を見た――
en_text:
Oh, the nightmares I have seen
in this place...

ja_text: ――ベルトリーニ家
en_text: House Bertolini—

ja_text:
鉱山を掘り当て
富豪となった名家じゃ
en_text:
They made their fortune in iron,
mining the rich veins beneath
their lands.

ja_text:
だが、ある時……
主が死に、遺産争いとなった
en_text:
But one day, the lord of the house
passed suddenly.

ja_text: 長女と次女は、強欲じゃった
en_text:
His two eldest daughters
were consumed with greed.

ja_text:
自らの取り分のため
親族を次々と殺していった
en_text:
Hoping to claim the entire fortune,
they assassinated their relatives...

ja_text:
そして、末娘の三女を
遠くへ売り飛ばした
en_text:
And sold their little sister to a
brothel in a far-off land.

ja_text:
長女と次女は
遺産を手にしたのじゃ
en_text: ...And so the fortune was theirs.

ja_text:
三女は遠い町で
娼婦として身銭を稼いだ
en_text:
In a distant land, their sister sold
her body for coin.

ja_text: 来る日も、来る日も……
en_text:
Day in, day out... Slowly building
her own humble fortune...

ja_text:
ある時、三女は
マフィアのボスに気に入られた
en_text:
Eventually, she caught the eye of a
powerful figure in the underworld...

ja_text:
ボスの女となり
地位を築き……
en_text:
She took her place as his mistress,
gaining more and more power...

ja_text:
数年後、三女は手下を懐柔し
ボスを暗殺した
en_text:
And befriended his lackeys, who then
killed their master at her command.

ja_text:
三女は、新たなボスとなり
生まれた屋敷へ帰る
en_text:
Taking her rightful place atop the
underworld, she returned home.

ja_text:
裕福な暮らしをしていた
長女と次女……
en_text:
When she saw her sisters
living their lavish lives...

ja_text:
その娘たちを手下に犯させ
一族を皆殺しにした
en_text:
She ordered her minions
to slaughter them.

ja_text:
三女は、遺産を奪い
それを元手に悪行を重ね
en_text:
She reclaimed the family fortune, and
grew it further through heinous deeds.

ja_text:
いまでは、大陸一の
大富豪にまでなったのじゃ
en_text:
Now, some say she owns all of the
continent...

ja_text: そして、その女が……
en_text: That woman...

ja_text:
大富豪ヘルミニア
……だろ？　じいさん
en_text:
...Is Lady Herminia.
Isn't that so, old man?

ja_text: ……いかにも
en_text: Indeed, my boy.

ja_text: おいおい、まじか！？
en_text:
Wh-what!?
You gotta be kidding me!

ja_text:
やっぱりイカレ女
じゃねえか！
en_text: I knew she was crazy, but—!

ja_text:
俺たちは、そのヘルミニアに
用があって来た
en_text:
We have business with
Lady Herminia.

ja_text: どいてくれるか？
en_text: Please, let us pass.

ja_text:
私は、あの屋敷で１人だけ
命拾いをした
en_text:
She left me maimed,
but my life was spared.

ja_text:
だが、二度と歩けない脚にされ
見張りをさせられとる
en_text: Since then, I keep watch here.

ja_text: ……手を引くべきじゃ
en_text:
...If you value your lives,
begone from this place.

ja_text:
あの魔女は
富に呪われておる
en_text: That woman is cursed by wealth.

ja_text: よく舌の回るじいさんだ
en_text: Thanks for the story, gramps.

ja_text:
行こうぜ、バルジェロ
タヴィアーニが待ってる
en_text:
Let's go, Boss.
Taviani's waiting for us.

ja_text: おい！！　あれ！
en_text: Good gods... Look!

ja_text: タヴィアーニ……
en_text: Taviani!

ja_text:
死んでる……
まじ……かよ……
en_text: He...he's dead!

ja_text:
一体どうなってる！？
何があったッ！？
en_text:
What in the gods' name happened
here!?

ja_text: バルジェロ、やばいぜ……
en_text:
I have a bad feeling
about this, Boss...

ja_text:
なあ、罠だ……
ずらかろうぜ！！
en_text:
It's a trap...
We need to get outta here!

ja_text: ……冷静になれ
en_text: ...Stay calm, Pierro.

ja_text:
あらあら
可愛い坊やたち
en_text:
Well, well. If it isn't that sweet
young man from the banquet...

ja_text: わたくしの庭で遊んでいるの？
en_text:
Come to play in my garden,
have you?

ja_text: ヘルミニア……！
en_text: Herminia!

ja_text:
ふふ、パーティで
見かけた坊やですわね
en_text:
Ohoho... Just as I thought.
It <i>is</> you.

ja_text:
ドン・タヴィアーニ……
目障りな存在でしたわ
en_text:
Lord Taviani was always buzzing
about, trying to suck my wealth
from me.

ja_text:
でも、その今際は
悲しいものでしたわ
en_text: Oh, but how tragic his end was...!

ja_text:
部下を殺され、独りになると
どうなさったと思って？
en_text:
After I killed his lackeys and stood
over him, what do you think he did?

ja_text:
わたくしの脚にすがって
命乞いをしましたのよ
en_text:
He clung to my leg and blathered
something about mercy!

ja_text:
あの哀れな眼……
くり抜いて飾りたいくらい
en_text:
His sad, sad eyes... I wished to
gouge them out so I could gaze
upon them forever!

ja_text: ふふ……
en_text: Ohoho...

ja_text: ほぉーっほっほっほっほ！！
en_text: Ohohohohoho!

ja_text: ひ……ひいぃ……
en_text: N-no...

ja_text: クソ魔女め……
en_text: Damn witch...

ja_text:
……ふふ
最高の賛辞ですわ
en_text: ...You honor me.

ja_text:
さ、残りの蚊も
叩き潰して差し上げて？
en_text:
Now...finish off the rest of
these insects, won't you?

ja_text: ソニア……
en_text: Sonia...

ja_text: なんで……？
en_text: What? Why...?

ja_text:
なんでそいつの隣に
いるンだよ、ソニア！？
en_text:
Why are you standing next
to that witch, Sonia!?

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様
お任せください
en_text: Leave them to me...my lady.

ja_text:
ふふ……頼もしいですわ
ソニアさん
en_text:
Ohoho... I knew I could
count on you, my dear.

ja_text:
タヴィアーニさんたちを
殺ったのはこの娘ですのよ？
en_text:
She was the one who killed Taviani
and the others, you know.

ja_text:
わたくしが買った
自慢の兵ですわ
en_text:
Why, dear Sonia is the best
bodyguard I've ever bought.

ja_text:
坊やたちがどんな顔で死ぬか
少し興味あるけど
en_text:
I'm curious to see the look on
<i>your</> faces when she kills you.

ja_text:
あいにく、商談があるの
御免遊ばせ
en_text: Alas...business calls.

ja_text:
ソニアさん？
苦しめて殺して差し上げて
en_text:
And Sonia...
Make sure they suffer, yes?

ja_text:
かしこまりました
ヘルミニア様
en_text: As you command, my lady.

ja_text:
……そういうこと
ここで死んで
en_text:
You heard Lady Herminia.
This is where you die.

ja_text: なぜだ……ソニア……
en_text: But Sonia... Why?

ja_text:
あたしの主は
ヘルミニア様よ
en_text: I serve Lady Herminia now.

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様はあたしに
富を与えてくださった
en_text:
She has given me riches
like you wouldn't believe...

ja_text: なん……だと……
en_text: What...what are you saying?

ja_text:
バルジェロ
あんたには分からない？
en_text: Don't you understand, Bargello!?

ja_text: この世は、富こそ全てよ
en_text: In this world, coin rules over all!

ja_text: 違う……
en_text: No...

ja_text:
富より価値あるものが
ここにはある……！
en_text:
That's not true... I have something
more valuable than money...

ja_text:
へえ……
だったら教えてよ？
en_text:
Oh, really? And what is this
oh-so-special thing?

ja_text:
どこにあるのよ
そんな素敵なモノがさ！
en_text:
What is it!? And why do you
keep it from me!?

ja_text:
バルジェロ！
来るぞ……！！
en_text: Here she comes, Boss!

ja_text: ソニア……！
en_text: Sonia—!

ja_text: バルジェロ！！
en_text: Bargello!

ja_text:
富より価値あるものが
あるって……
en_text:
Something more valuable
than money...

ja_text: あたしも……そう思ってた
en_text: I once believed in that, too...

ja_text: 喋るな、ソニア
en_text: Shh! Save your breath, Sonia...

ja_text:
だけど、ヘルミニア様に買われ
富ある暮らしを知った
en_text:
But after Lady Herminia bought me,
and I learned to live in luxury...

ja_text:
こんな世界があるんだって……
生まれ変わったみたいに
en_text:
It was as if I'd been reborn...
into the world of my dreams.

ja_text:
忘れてたわ……
シロブドウ畑のこと
en_text: I had...forgotten...the vineyards...

ja_text:
ヘルミニア様が
教えてくれたの……
en_text:
I still remember what she
told me...

ja_text:
生まれる家は選べない
でも、生き方は選べるって
en_text:
You cannot choose where you are
born, but you can choose how to live.

ja_text:
あたしも……
あの方のようになりたかった
en_text: All I wanted...was to live like her!

ja_text: ……いつの間にか
en_text: Before...I knew it...

ja_text: ねえ……バルジェロ？
en_text: Bargello...

ja_text:
もう一度見たい……
一緒に……
en_text:
Let's go...see them again...
Together...

ja_text: 春が来たら……
en_text: Yes...next spring...

ja_text: シロブドウの花……
en_text: When the harvest...comes...

ja_text: バルジェロ……
en_text: Bargello...

ja_text: ……アジトに戻ろう
en_text: We should go back.

ja_text:
富がソニアを
変えてしまった
en_text:
Wealth changed her into someone
I barely recognized...

ja_text: 富とはなんだ……？
en_text:
Why is money so damned
powerful?

ja_text: さあな……
en_text: Beats me...

ja_text:
だが、仕方ねえさ
誰でも金は欲しい
en_text:
But what can you do?
Everyone wants to be rich.

ja_text:
死んだら
大金もクソと同じだぜ
en_text:
Yeah, coin won't do you any good
if you're dead.

ja_text: ……全くだ
en_text: ...You can say that again.

ja_text:
ヘルミニアは富を餌に
人の心を操る
en_text:
Herminia uses her riches to buy
people's hearts...and their souls.

ja_text:
利用された人間は
数え切れないだろう
en_text:
Who knows how many poor
bastards have been used by her?

ja_text: こんな町じゃ、誰も報われない
en_text:
There's no happiness here.
Only the used...and the users.

ja_text:
少しは
マシな町にしなければ……
en_text:
But this is going to change.
Damn it all, this will change...

ja_text:
続きを言ってくれ
ボス
en_text: So what's next for us, Boss?

ja_text:
ヘルミニアの屋敷へ
乗り込むぞ
en_text:
We're going to pay a visit to
that witch at her home.

ja_text: そうこなくちゃな
en_text: Now we're talking!

ja_text:
だが、タヴィアーニは死んだ
後ろ盾もないぜ？
en_text:
But Taviani won't have our backs
this time. What do we do?

ja_text: 俺に考えがある
en_text: I have a plan.

ja_text: ……クールだ
en_text: ...It's go time.

ja_text: ヘルミニア様
en_text: Lady Herminia.

ja_text:
ソニアが……
しくじったようです
en_text:
I regret to say that Sonia...
failed you.

ja_text:
ああ、そうですの？
次を探しておきなさい
en_text:
Oh, is that so?
Well, find me a new one, then.

ja_text:
……あの坊や
バルジェロ、でしたっけ
en_text:
That young man...
Bargello, was it?

ja_text:
あの、静かに燃える
情熱的な眼……
en_text:
Those eyes, calm yet burning
with passion...

ja_text:
ふふ……初めて見たとき
少し昂ぶりましたの
en_text:
The first time I saw them,
I almost felt...aroused.

ja_text: それに……あの子……
en_text: And that other one...

ja_text: ウィッシュベール出身のようです
en_text: It seems they're from Wishvale.

ja_text: うふふ……
en_text: Ohohoho...

ja_text:
ねえ……
また増えましたわよ？
en_text:
I've brought more gold and jewels
to keep you company...

ja_text: ガブリエラ姉様
en_text: Gabriella...

ja_text: アニータ姉様
en_text: Anita...

ja_text:
喜ばないの？
大好きな金貨ですわ
en_text:
My dearest sisters...are you
not happy? You always adored
riches so...

ja_text:
……ああ、喋れませんわね
金で固めてありますもの
en_text:
Oh, that's right...
You can't speak anymore.

ja_text: ふふ……
en_text: Ohohoho...

ja_text:
苦しみ、死、絶望に染まる
その表情……
en_text:
Your pained, hopeless death masques
frozen in gold for eternity...

ja_text:
た……
たまらなく好きですわぁ……
en_text: How fitting... How perfect...

ja_text:
どんな宝石より
輝いていますわよ、お姉様……
en_text:
Are you not happy, my sisters?
You shine greater than any gem...

ja_text: ふん、ふん、ふ～ん
en_text: La la la♪

ja_text:
そこで、そうやって
見ていらして？
en_text: Yes, watch me, my dear sisters...

ja_text:
わたくしが、世の富を
全て手に入れるのを……
en_text:
Watch me take everything
in this world...

ja_text: ここは……？
en_text: What is this place?

ja_text:
お姉様たち……
どうなさったの？
en_text:
My dear sisters...
Whatever is the matter?
What...?

ja_text:
どうなさったの……
お、お姉様……
en_text: My dear...sisters...

ja_text: グレゴリ……？
en_text: Gregory...?

ja_text:
貴方も、わたくしが
殺したはずじゃ……
en_text: But I killed you, too...

ja_text:
金も部下も
全てを奪って……
en_text:
I took your money...your loyal
servants...everything...

ja_text: ぐふッ……
en_text: Urgh...
Ugh...you...

ja_text: 貴方たち……
en_text: You bastards...

ja_text:
わたくしの富を
奪いに来ましたのね……？
en_text:
You came back to take my
riches from me...didn't you?
